The arrival of Oroborous was unexpected to say the least. Although cases of elderly Chlora and Fulcrid dying with the Shiny Eyed Sickness started to crop up just a few months before, many never thought it to be an omen of something so huge and destructive. Well, whatever it was, it was currently strangling the Tree of Life, and was trying to consume it, trapping those in the tree.

Many messengers were sent along Unity Road towards Reginapolis, trying to get a response from the Queen. The first messenger already described the situation as a desperate siege. Chlora and Fulcrid administrators were ripped apart by the many scaly maws. Luckily, the beast was slowed down by it's unnatural and tainted soul being rejected by the tree's blessing protect those with souls from within. The second, third, fourth, and other messengers, however, reported the same story, but in a more out of breath fashion. This attack on both Chloran and Fulcrid citizens required the drafting of the Union' first standing army.

The Queen had called all the Crassuczar surrounding Reginaoplis and they their Crass. Messengers were sent to those Grand Crassuses farther away, with orders to raise all the spiders they could find willing to fight. These spiders, along with the Crassuczar who mustered them, were to gather in [Faeni Transibit](https://i.sli.mg/cHdI2a.jpg), as it's spacious hilly plains and proximity to the Tree would allow for a perfect window of attack. The Queen chose the Crassuczar of [Regina Murum](https://i.sli.mg/SXjMPY.jpg), Tres Oculos to lead this new army. Messengers were also sent into Chloran lands to rally those who wanted to fight and secure their homelands, and they were told to rally their forces at [Faeni Transibit](https://i.sli.mg/fKIiVZ.jpg) as well to press a simultaneous attack. Finally, a last messenger was to be sent along the southern edge of Chloran territory to try and rally the Chloran of the western highlands, so that they could come in to aid the attack as well.

But as the army started to assemble, more frantic Chlora and Fulcrid arrived with dire news. The Tree had been mostly consumed at this point. Oroborous had also used it's extreme reach to find these mysterious, divine fruits that supposedly floated high above the tree. Once they were consumed, these gigantic plant beings fell from the sky, and started to massacre the Chlora and Fulcrid alike as well. There are also reports of Daemon pouring out of the mouths of the creature, Daemons who killed just as indiscriminately and ruthlessly as their host. The only good news to come out of these future messages was that the Djinn of the Gaea had been awakened, and was proving to be an excellent distraction to Oroborous. It was actually starting to lead the beast away from the tree at that point. But this good news was not enough to outweigh the bad, and the Queen went to thinking on new ways to handle the situation.

Meanwhile, on the other side of the Dynasty, Johbla had just received the last SeaFairer expedition ship. Johbla was doubtful of the expeditions when the first ship reported seeing exotic and new Chlora, which Johbla was well of existing. He became even more downtrodden about it when a second explorer returned with their greatest discovery being some "strange Fulcrid like creatures that weren't Fulcrid at all". Whatever that meant, it was useless to him. Johbla was on the verge of giving up entirely, until the last surviving explorer returned with news of a piece of land suitable for a canal.

The sound of that news re-aroused Johbla's hopes, as he immediately went about organizing a digging party to help build the canal. But the excitement died down, as Johbla realized that his spiders alone could not accomplish the task of digging out the canal, organizing transportation through it, and protecting it from sabotage by the Hag. No, the Fulcrid were much too stupid for this, and the SeaFairer much too treacherous. Johbla realized, he would need the help of those who were on the other side of the isthmus to help him. Johbla ordered a messenger be sent of to Sentenza, with hopes of collaborations between the two occurring.
